headline: Government Considers Restructuring 6–7 Trillion Won in "COVID Debt" for Self-Employed and Small Business Owners
summary: The government is considering a bulk write-off of 6 to 7 trillion won in long-overdue receivables held by public financial institutions from self-employed and small business owners. The base rate has risen above 3%.
why: Public financial institutions such as state lenders hold large loan books, and write-offs affect their balance sheets and the fiscal cost borne by taxpayers.
